# Generated by tools/gen_skonester_121_legacy_building_tools.py.
# Province-scope adapters. No vanilla helper override or trade-post ownership changes.
# New districts require a free slot and legal construction for their primary building.

skonester_121_upgrade_line_once_effect = {
	every_built_buildings = {
		limit = { is_building_or_higher = $BUILDING$ can_building_be_upgraded = yes }
		upgrade_this_building = yes
	}
}

skonester_121_max_existing_line_effect = {
	while = {
		count = 8
		skonester_121_upgrade_line_once_effect = { BUILDING = $BUILDING$ }
	}
}

skonester_121_build_regular_line_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_holding = yes
			NOT = { province_has_district = $DISTRICT$ }
			has_free_district_slot = yes
			can_start_building_construction_for_owner = $PRIMARY$
		}
		add_regular_district = $DISTRICT$
	}
	every_built_regular_district = {
		limit = {
			has_building_or_higher = $PRIMARY$
			NOT = { has_building_or_higher = $BUILDING$ }
			can_start_building_construction_for_owner = $BUILDING$
		}
		add_building = $BUILDING$
	}
}

# 1.20 barracks -> 1.21 mustering_grounds_1 in military_district.
skonester_121_build_barracks_effect = {
	skonester_121_build_regular_line_effect = {
		BUILDING = mustering_grounds_1
		PRIMARY = pb_military_01
		DISTRICT = military_district
	}
}

skonester_121_upgrade_barracks_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building_or_higher = mustering_grounds_1 }
		skonester_121_max_existing_line_effect = { BUILDING = pb_military_01 }
		skonester_121_max_existing_line_effect = { BUILDING = mustering_grounds_1 }
	}
}

skonester_121_max_barracks_effect = {
	skonester_121_build_barracks_effect = yes
	skonester_121_max_existing_line_effect = { BUILDING = pb_military_01 }
	skonester_121_build_barracks_effect = yes
	skonester_121_upgrade_barracks_effect = yes
}

skonester_121_advance_barracks_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building_or_higher = mustering_grounds_1 }
		skonester_121_upgrade_line_once_effect = { BUILDING = pb_military_01 }
		skonester_121_upgrade_line_once_effect = { BUILDING = mustering_grounds_1 }
	}
	else = {
		skonester_121_build_barracks_effect = yes
	}
}

# 1.20 castle -> 1.21 castle_01 in castle_holding_district.
skonester_121_build_castle_effect = {
	holding_district ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_building_or_higher = castle_01 } can_start_building_construction_for_owner = castle_01 }
			add_building = castle_01
		}
	}
}

skonester_121_upgrade_castle_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building_or_higher = castle_01 }
		skonester_121_max_existing_line_effect = { BUILDING = castle_01 }
		skonester_121_max_existing_line_effect = { BUILDING = castle_01 }
	}
}

skonester_121_max_castle_effect = {
	skonester_121_build_castle_effect = yes
	skonester_121_max_existing_line_effect = { BUILDING = castle_01 }
	skonester_121_build_castle_effect = yes
	skonester_121_upgrade_castle_effect = yes
}

skonester_121_advance_castle_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building_or_higher = castle_01 }
		skonester_121_upgrade_line_once_effect = { BUILDING = castle_01 }
		skonester_121_upgrade_line_once_effect = { BUILDING = castle_01 }
	}
	else = {
		skonester_121_build_castle_effect = yes
	}
}

	skonester_121_build_hunting_grounds_effect = yes
	skonester_121_max_existing_line_effect = { BUILDING = pb_villages_01 }
	skonester_121_build_hunting_grounds_effect = yes
	skonester_121_upgrade_hunting_grounds_effect = yes
}

		skonester_121_upgrade_line_once_effect = { BUILDING = pb_villages_01 }
		skonester_121_upgrade_line_once_effect = { BUILDING = village_hunter_1 }

# 1.20 megalith -> 1.21 megalith_1 in temple_holding_district.
skonester_121_build_megalith_effect = {
	holding_district ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_building_or_higher = megalith_1 } can_start_building_construction_for_owner = megalith_1 }
			add_building = megalith_1
		}
	}
}

skonester_121_upgrade_megalith_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building_or_higher = megalith_1 }
		skonester_121_max_existing_line_effect = { BUILDING = temple_01 }
		skonester_121_max_existing_line_effect = { BUILDING = megalith_1 }
	}
}

skonester_121_max_megalith_effect = {
	skonester_121_build_megalith_effect = yes
	skonester_121_max_existing_line_effect = { BUILDING = temple_01 }
	skonester_121_build_megalith_effect = yes
	skonester_121_upgrade_megalith_effect = yes
}

skonester_121_advance_megalith_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building_or_higher = megalith_1 }
		skonester_121_upgrade_line_once_effect = { BUILDING = temple_01 }
		skonester_121_upgrade_line_once_effect = { BUILDING = megalith_1 }
	}
	else = {
		skonester_121_build_megalith_effect = yes
	}
}

skonester_121_advance_ramparts_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building_or_higher = ramparts_1 }
		skonester_121_upgrade_line_once_effect = { BUILDING = pb_walls_01 }
		skonester_121_upgrade_line_once_effect = { BUILDING = ramparts_1 }
	}
	else = {
		skonester_121_build_ramparts_effect = yes
	}
}

# 1.20 temple -> 1.21 temple_01 in temple_holding_district.
skonester_121_build_temple_effect = {
	holding_district ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_building_or_higher = temple_01 } can_start_building_construction_for_owner = temple_01 }
			add_building = temple_01
		}
	}
}
